brands.description: DEMCO valves are Cameron’s resilient-seated butterfly valves, now part of Cameron Valves & Measurement, an SLB business. Indus Hydraulics is an authorised DEMCO distributor in the UAE. We supply the NE-C general-purpose, NE-I, NE-I Sanitary, NE-D, NEI-T Teflon-lined and NF-C large-bore series from 2″ to 36″ (50 to 900 mm), in wafer and lug bodies, with the body, stem, disc and seat materials the service calls for. Accessories cover locking and memory-stop handles, worm-gear operators, Series DR pneumatic actuators, stem extensions, position-indicator switches, solenoid valves and positioners. DEMCO butterfly valves serve chemical and petrochemical, food and beverage, water and waste water, HVAC, power, mining, dry bulk and marine duty. We also carry DEMCO DM gate valve spares: gates, seat inserts, seat assemblies, stems and repair kits. Send a DEMCO part number such as J022122-1215311 and we read it back to series, size, body, disc and seat before we quote.
